extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers/editors who want to create or locate an article (e.g., on 'Sketch show pilot')
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users attempting to create or find a Wikipedia page (here: 'Sketch show pilot'), including account requirements, searching/troubleshooting, capitalization/redirect advice, and what to do if a page was deleted or recently created.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the article because you are not autoconfirmed, alternatives include using the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or requesting a new article. This is a procedural requirement to create pages on English Wikipedia.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article (alternative path)
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is provided as an alternative for users who cannot directly create articles (e.g., not autoconfirmed) — submit a draft via the wizard or request creation so experienced editors can review or create the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'Sketch show pilot' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, perform a search to avoid duplicates or to find existing coverage under a different title or spelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages linking to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect incoming links to determine whether related content already exists and to identify appropriate placement or redirects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allow for propagation delay / purge cache
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a recently-created page is not showing, either wait for the database to update or manually purge the page to force an update.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check capitalization and consider redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify alternative capitalizations/spellings before creating a new page. If an existing page uses a different capitalization, create a redirect from the variant to the canonical title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log when a page is missing
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the title previously existed but is missing, consult the deletion log to learn whether it was removed and why; that may inform whether recreation is appropriate or what changes are needed.
